title: Blake Lively's Case Against Social Media Guru Jed Wallace Once Again Dismissed By Judge | Hollywood News - News18
text: Blake Lively has suffered a blow to her ongoing case against her It Ends With Us co-star Justin Baldoni. On Wednesday, November 5, the judge dismissed her claims against Jed Wallace, a social media guru, whom she had accused of helping to smear her reputation online during the release of the romantic drama in 2024. She alleged that Jed teamed up with Justin to damage her reputation. Judge Lewis Liman ruled that the actress’ legal team failed to show that Jed, based in Austin, Texas, had sufficient ties to New York to be sued there. Back in July, the judge had dismissed her claims against the social media guru but allowed Blake and her team to try again with more evidence to establish his connection to New York. This time, the judge said the case still did not meet the legal requirements. Blake Lively Can Sue Jed Wallace In Texas New York’s “long-arm" statute makes it possible for plaintiffs to sue someone from another state, given they can prove that an injury occurred in the state. But the same statute exempts defamation claims, which played a big part in the decision. The judge has also said that the actress may be able to sue Jed Wallace in Texas. It remains unclear whether she would file a case against him in his home state. “The Court ruled that Ms. Lively’s claims can and should be brought in a different court. Ms. Lively is evaluating her many options for doing so, and looks forward to trial on all of her claims against Baldoni, Heath, Nathan, and the rest of the Wayfarer defendants in March in New York," a spokesperson for Blake said in a statement, as quoted by Variety. In a federal lawsuit filed in December last year, the 38-year-old actress claimed that the Texas-based social media guru ran an untraceable smear campaign against her for Justin Baldoni, whom she accused of sexual harassment. She claimed that after she spoke up about the sexual harassment on set, the actor-director and others worked to turn people online against her. She sued Justin, publicist Melissa Nathan, producer Jamey Heath, and others. The trial in the case is expected to begin in March 2026. Jed Wallace Sued Blake Lively In Texas Meanwhile, Jed Wallace is suing Blake in Texas, saying that she defamed him. Justin’s lawyer reacted to the court’s recent ruling on the case, saying, “We are grateful for the Court’s order today, making clear that the claims against Mr. Wallace never belonged in this court." Bryan Freedman, who is representing the Jane the Virgin actor and others, continued, “Allegations that he participated in any smear campaign are unsupported, and all claims against him have been dismissed by this court. The other defendants look forward to their day in court when they will show there is no merit to Ms. Lively’s claims against them."
